summary: Retested 3 reported bug fixes on /play. All three PASS. Full regression flow (upload -> launch -> play -> back) also works. Frontend-only testing at 1920x1080.
passed: BUG1 - Gradient animation: 5 .blob elements found under [data-testid=mesh-gradient]. Blob[0] animation-name='blob-drift-1', animation-duration='14s'. Computed transform at t=0: matrix(1.0882, 0, 0, 1.0882, -14.9365, -27.272), rect.x=-235.91. At t=2500ms: matrix(1.34423, 0, 0, 1.34423, 520.799, 113.869), rect.x=132.07. Blob visibly moved and scaled - animation is running.

BUG2 - No reflow on activation: All 8 lyric lines share identical computed fontSize='96px', lineHeight='96px', fontWeight='700' regardless of active/inactive state. Active line (i=0, opacity 0.999, transform scale~1.0) and dimmed lines (opacity 0.28-0.6, transform scale 0.7-0.82) differ ONLY by transform (scale) and opacity/filter - font-size is constant so no text re-wrap on activation.

BUG3 - Smooth transitions: Computed transition-property on .lyric-line = 'transform, opacity, filter, color' (does NOT contain bare 'all'). transition-duration = '0.9s' (~900ms). Meets requirement for GPU-friendly, buttery transitions.

Regression: Upload form accepts artist/song text + audio.wav + art.png + sample.lrc, Launch Player navigates to /play, intro renders, play-button (data-testid) starts playback, first lyric activates ~t=3s at 96px/700 bold white, back-button returns to '/' successfully.

raw_observations.note_pause_click: Second click on play-button timed out because on-screen controls auto-hide after inactivity; not a bug - back-button click succeeded which confirms controls layer is functional. Playback state changed correctly on first click (progress advanced to 0:04).
